title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Tariff Rule: Pricing the Corrected Time Charge by Length of Rental
content:
**Tariff rule.** The price of the corrected time charge of a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network repair follows the length of the rental: a rental of seven or more rental days is charged one block rate for each full seven-day block plus the remainder charge for its remaining rental days; a rental of at least the weekly-rate threshold of 5 rental days (the same 5 days in every class) but fewer than seven rental days is charged the lesser of its rental days at the class partner daily rate and one class weekly rate; a shorter rental is charged its rental days at the class partner daily rate. The full blocks are priced first, the remainder second, and the two amounts are added to give the corrected time charge before it is compared with the posted time charge.

Rental days are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day.

## Length bands

| Rental days | Corrected time charge |
|---|---|
| 1 to 4 | The rental days at the class partner daily rate |
| 5 or 6 | The lesser of the rental days at the class partner daily rate and one class weekly rate |
| 7 or more | One block rate per full seven-day block, plus the remainder charge for the remaining rental days |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Economy Rental, partner daily rate 39.99 USD, weekly rate 229.00 USD)

- 4 rental days, under the threshold of 5: 4 days at 39.99 USD, 159.96 USD.
- 5 rental days, at the threshold: the lesser of 199.95 USD and 229.00 USD, that is 199.95 USD.
- 6 rental days: the lesser of 239.94 USD and 229.00 USD, that is 229.00 USD.
- 7 rental days: one full seven-day block at the block rate, and no remaining rental days.
- 10 rental days: one full block at the block rate, plus the remainder charge for 3 remaining rental days, the two amounts added.

## Counting the days (hypothetical)

Pickup on the 3rd at 14:00 and return on the 9th at 13:00: 6 whole days between the dates and a return time earlier than the pickup time, so 6 rental days, in the 5-or-6 band. Returned instead on the 9th at 15:00, the rental has 7 rental days.
